candidates.change_summary: Remove the require statement that checks locked_ to allow reentrant calls.
Remove the locked_ = true assignment so the lock is never set.
Remove the locked_ = false reset so the modifier stays locked after first use.
Remove the line that adds msg.value to acc.balance so Put never increases balance.
Replace add_uint256 with a plain addition that can overflow, changing balance on overflow.
Replace _unlockTime with block.timestamp so the stored unlock time always equals the current block timestamp.
Delete the modifier nonReentrant_ from Put to allow reentrant calls that affect later Puts.
Remove the require check on MinSum so Collect succeeds even if balance is below MinSum.
Invert the unlock time condition so Collect succeeds only before unlock time instead of after.
Replace the sub_uint256 balance decrement with an addition so balance increases on Collect.
Change the call recipient from msg.sender to a hardcoded zero address so funds are sent elsewhere.
Remove the MinSum minimum from the condition so Collect succeeds with any balance above zero.
Remove the nonReentrant guard from the modifier so reentrant calls are allowed.
Delete the nonReentrant_ modifier from Collect, removing the reentrancy guard.
Delete the if-statement guard in Collect so that the withdrawal and balance update always execute.
Replace the pre-call balance subtraction with a post-call pre-call subtraction using old balance, i.e. move the balance update to occur after the external call instead of before it.
Replace the equality/inequality condition block.timestamp>acc.unlockTime with block.timestamp>=acc.unlockTime, allowing collection exactly at unlockTime.
Replace acc.balance>=_am with acc.balance>_am, disallowing collection of exactly the full balance.
Delete the first require(!locked_) statement from nonReentrant_, removing the reentrancy check.
Delete the locked_ = false reset at the end of nonReentrant_, leaving the contract permanently locked after first use.
Delete the locked_ = true assignment in nonReentrant_ so the guard never actually locks.
Move the balance subtraction and log update to occur before the external call in Collect.
Delete the nonReentrant_ modifier invocation from Collect, removing the reentrancy guard.
Change the Collect guard to use the caller's balance instead of the caller's unlockTime when checking block.timestamp.
Replace the log data string in Collect from "Collect" to "Put".
Delete the nonReentrant_ modifier's locked_ check requirement, weakening the guard.
Set locked_ to false at the start of nonReentrant_, making the guard ineffective.
